14645: RV park at 5311 South Beach Boulevard, Bay St. Louis, with Gulf views and the beach across the road: 37 concrete full-hookup pads (30/50 amp) and 31 dry sites, all with free Wi-Fi.  There is no bathhouse; RVs must be self-contained, showers and bathrooms included.  Golf carts can be rented for the five-minute ride to the Silver Slipper Casino, and sites can be booked up to a year ahead. --Claude
14655: Golf and RV resort at 596 Hwy 317, nine miles northeast of Ashdown and 0.9 miles from Yarborough Landing on Millwood Lake, now under new ownership as Millwood Golf and RV Resort.  It has full-hookup and pull-through RV sites, an 18-hole championship golf course, two catch-and-release fishing ponds, a seasonal outdoor pool, a clubhouse, hot showers, a laundry and free Wi-Fi; lakeside cabins with kitchenettes are rented too. --Claude
14671: RV park at 1514 Azema Street, Vinton, near Interstate 10 and the Louisiana–Texas state line and 5 miles from Delta Downs, with back-in and pull-through full-hookup sites.  There is a swimming pool and water slide, a rec room and billiard table, indoor restrooms and showers, a laundry and free Wi-Fi, and pets are welcome.  Check-in is at 3 p.m. and checkout at noon, quiet hours run from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m., and fireworks are prohibited; a long-term stay in an RV or camper older than five years needs management's approval. --Claude
14708: RV park at 720 S Rockwell Ave, just off I-40 on the west side of Oklahoma City, open for over 30 years and now under new ownership: 170 full-hookup sites, 20 to 25 ft wide and up to 80 ft long, many of them pull-throughs.  It shares a property line with Crystal Lake, stocked with sunfish and catfish, and sits on a paved regional bike trail.  There is an indoor heated pool, spa and sauna, two bathhouses with private showers, a laundry, fiber Wi-Fi throughout, a storm shelter, propane exchange and refills, workout machines, a dog park and a playground. --Claude
14711: SteadyStays park at 774 Cooper Memorial Dr, Sulphur, managed by Streamside RV Parks & Campgrounds, on over 20 landscaped acres minutes from Lake of the Arbuckles, Turner Falls and the Chickasaw National Recreation Area.  Its back-in sites have 30/50-amp full hookups, picnic tables and charcoal grills; campers can fish the catch-and-release ponds without a license, and there is a pool, a zip line, a ninja warrior course, disc golf, a gem-mining sluice, a dog park, a laundry and free Wi-Fi.  A reservation covers up to 4 people, 8 at most; fireworks and generators aren't allowed, and quiet hours run from 10 p.m. to 8 a.m. --Claude
14847: AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+.  Family-owned snowbird resort at 10498 N. Frontage Rd. on Yuma's I-8 corridor, with over 250 full-hookup sites (30/50 amp), big-rig pull-throughs and concrete patios; stays run from a night to a full year, annual residents make it their permanent address, and park models are sold.  There is a heated pool and spa, a fitness center, a game room, pickleball, shuffleboard and bocce courts, a clubhouse, tiled showers and restrooms, a laundry, and free Wi-Fi and cable at every site. --Claude
14851: AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+.  Adult-only park at 2900 West 5th Street, Yuma, established in 1987 and open all year, with 110 spaces, all with concrete patios, grass and citrus trees, and 30-amp full hookups.  There is a putting green, a solar-heated pool, shuffleboard, horseshoes, a rec hall, a laundry room and free Wi-Fi; guests stay from a night to the whole season, and dogs must weigh 35 pounds or less. --Claude
14939: Campground in Green Park Provincial Park, Port Hill (364 Green Park Rd), 6 km east of Tyne Valley beside the shipbuilding museum, run for the province by a leaseholder, KW Green Park Campground: 22 three-way and 20 two-way RV sites, 80 tent sites, riverfront cabins and a river beach, on 219 acres.  There are 12 hot showers, a laundromat, a kitchen shelter, a dumping station and a campers' store, and pets are allowed on a leash. --Claude
1496: Resort on 70 acres at Pond Eddy, on Route 97 16 miles north of Port Jervis, with nearly a mile of Delaware River frontage: year-round full-hookup RV sites (20/30/50 amp) overlooking the river, riverside, brookside and woods tent sites, cabins and a tiny home, and 2 miles of hiking trails.  It runs half- and full-day rafting, canoeing and tubing trips and has an on-site restaurant with an outdoor bar. --Claude
3106: City of Fayette park and campground on an island formed by the Volga River, reached by a bridge, with RV sites (30- and 50-amp electric and water) on open grassy loops, tent sites, a playground, three large picnic shelters and easy river access for kayaking, canoeing and tubing; the camping loops sit back from the water behind a treeline.  The modern restrooms and showers are typically open from April through October, and the dump station costs $2.  Campers register and pay by QR code within an hour of arrival, stays are limited to 14 consecutive days, quiet hours run from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m., and check-out is at 4 p.m. --Claude
2765: Adams County Fairgrounds camping at 947 South Baltimore, Hastings, with 396 hookup sites: 20 back-in full-service sites south of the grandstands (upgraded to 50/30 amp in 2021), 86 water-and-electric and 290 electric-only, plus a tent field, a shower house and a dump station at the entrance that takes free-will donations.  The campground is seasonal, opening and closing with the weather, and closes to the public during several fairground events.  RV stays are limited to three weeks and tent stays to one, and campfires aren't allowed. --Claude
2827: City of Scottsbluff campground in Riverside Park, with views of Scotts Bluff National Monument: 43 pull-through RV sites, full-hookup or water-and-electric, and 20 tent sites, each with a fire ring and picnic table, plus free Wi-Fi and a bathhouse.  The park has playgrounds, disc golf, a dog park, fishing ponds and the Riverside Discovery Center zoo.  It is open all year, though the bathrooms and showers close in the off-season; RV stays are limited to 14 days and tent stays to 7, and golf carts and UTVs aren't allowed.  The pads sit well back from the North Platte River, behind open ground, an internal road and a treeline. --Claude
9254: Regional park at 301 Highway 6 South, Watson, with 14 full-service sites on spacious gravel lots (eight 50-amp and six 30-amp, all with potable water and sewer) and one 15-amp site without services; registered campers use a shower house at the west end of the clubhouse.  The park has a 9-hole golf course and licensed clubhouse, a swimming pool, mini golf, a playground and a large gazebo. --Claude
1763: Family-owned campground at 2759 1500 East Township Rd, Keithsburg, next to Big River State Forest, whose horse trails can be ridden straight from its equestrian sites; it also has a 50-acre dirt-bike and ATV park with a motocross track.  The 100 sites have 30- and 50-amp hookups, picnic tables and fire rings, water spigots around the camp, and pull-in, back-in or pull-through parking; there is a remodeled shower house, a clubhouse with restrooms and showers, a playground and a dump station, and ice and wood are sold. --Claude
